hebrews.6.p1.b1.text: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity …

hebrews.6.p1.b2.text: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

hebrews.6.p1.b3.text: And this we will do, if God permits.

hebrews.6.p2.b4.text: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

hebrews.6.p2.b5.text: and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.

hebrews.6.p2.b6.text: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.

hebrews.6.p2.b7.text: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.

hebrews.6.p3.b8.text: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.

hebrews.6.p3.b9.text: For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work … as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.

hebrews.6.p3.b10.text: Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.

hebrews.6.p4.b11.text: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,

hebrews.6.p4.b12.text: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”

hebrews.6.p4.b13.text: And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.

hebrews.6.p5.b14.text: … we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.

hebrews.6.p5.b15.text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

hebrews.6.p5.b16.text: where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
